caption: : Avg. rate at which the model attends most to each input segment: context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts) during generation.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average rate at which a model attends most to each input segment—context, generated response, or other (e.g., system prompts)—during generation, comparing two approaches: "Ours" and "Standard." The vertical axis lists the two methods, with "Ours" at the top and "Standard" below, while the horizontal axis represents the percentage of attention allocation, scaled from 0% to 100% in increments of 10%. Each bar is segmented into three colored portions corresponding to the legend: blue for "Context," orange for "Generated Response," and green for "Other." For "Ours," the blue segment (Context) is the largest at 60.6%, followed by the orange segment (Generated Response) at 31.7%, and the green segment (Other) at 7.7%. For "Standard," the orange segment (Generated Response) is the largest at 51.1%, followed by the green segment (Other) at 25.3%, and the blue segment (Context) at 23.6%. The bars are arranged horizontally and sorted by method, with no visual emphasis or annotations on specific segments. The chart visually demonstrates that the "Ours" method allocates significantly more attention to the context compared to the "Standard" method, which focuses more on the generated response and other components.
